subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Its sound was rougher than the modern bell, but people listened closely.”?
options: It reminded them that institutions are built not only by rules, but by repeated human actions.
The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on layers of earlier footsteps.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.
